result.summary: The image shows a wide residential street with sidewalks on both sides and mature trees providing shade on the right. The roadway features multiple lanes, including a dedicated bus lane, but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. While the right-side sidewalk is well-maintained, the left-side walkway is narrow and lacks a substantial buffer from traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway and Lack of Crossings
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway lacks marked crossings, which may encourage high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A continuous line of parked cars on the right side of the street can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway with Minimal Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left side is very narrow and directly adjacent to a bus lane, providing little physical or psychological separation from large vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the fence line

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a designated and safer place for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions or Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a marked bike lane and a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a small buffer and a curb. While mature trees provide shade and a pleasant environment, the lack of marked crossings and potential sightline obstructions from vegetation and utility poles are notable safety concerns.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and signals are present, the wide roadway and lack of traffic calming measures suggest a moderate risk environment.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a large mature tree and utility pole that completely obstruct the narrow sidewalk at a marked crosswalk. This physical barrier forces pedestrians into the roadway and creates significant sightline obstructions between drivers and people attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Major Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree trunk and utility pole occupy the entire width of the sidewalk, making it impassable for wheelchairs and forcing all pedestrians into the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The large tree trunk blocks the visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the edge of the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extension (Bulb-out)
interventions.description: Install a curb extension to move the pedestrian waiting area into the driver's line of sight and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Realignment
interventions.description: Widen or realign the sidewalk to provide a continuous, unobstructed path of travel around the existing tree.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.
